notes.title: Quickfix 1
notes.content:
Hey! I hope you like the game so far! Here's some quickfixes after launch.


 Bullet will break after hitting another bullet
 Starting a dialogue won't skip first line automatically
 Bullet will break after shoting at door (first step)
 Lobby button leading to the dark lobby in Dark Mode
 Lobby button disabled from first room 


Thank you for playing Towerheart!
